description: Defines adapter classes for WebSocket streams to interface with TCP/TLS, HTTP/2, and HTTP/3 (QUIC) streams, including delegate interfaces and methods for reading, writing, and handling stream events.

classes.name: WebSocketClientSocketHandleAdapter
classes.description: Adapter to make WebSocketBasicStream use a TCP/IP or TLS socket.

classes.name: WebSocketSpdyStreamAdapter
classes.description: Adapter to make WebSocketBasicStream use an HTTP/2 stream, forwarding headers and data events.

classes.name: WebSocketQuicStreamAdapter
classes.description: Adapter to make WebSocketBasicStream use an HTTP/3 (QUIC) stream, forwarding headers and stream events.

classes.name: WebSocketSpdyStreamAdapter::Delegate
classes.description: Interface for forwarding SPDY/HTTP2 stream events to a delegate.

classes.name: WebSocketQuicStreamAdapter::Delegate
classes.description: Interface for forwarding QUIC stream events to a delegate.
